contracts: (Every S11 aggregate execution has a deterministic terminal state, and budget exhaustion is unsuccessful.) AND (The S11 selector observes an exhausted time or output budget and an unsuccessful deterministic terminal state.) AND (The boundary selector observes configured finite output accounting and an unsuccessful deterministic terminal state on exhaustion.)

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.

selector_intents: Execute the authored S11 selector with an exhausted time or output budget; it fails until the terminal outcome is deterministically unsuccessful.
Run the S11 aggregate selector with an execution that would otherwise end indeterminately and require a failed runtime observation.
Run the aggregate boundary selector with output beyond its configured finite limit and require rejection as an unsuccessful deterministic terminal state.
